Trial_Structure.Stimulus_duration: Until response or maximum 1500 ms (shape-label pair)
Trial_Structure.ITI: 500 ms black screen at trial start
Trial_Structure.Feedback_duration: / (feedback 'incorrect'/'please respond faster' on error or timeout)

Stimulus_Properties.Shape: Geometric shapes (circle Kreis.png and triangle Dreieck.png), approx 5 degrees x 5 degrees visual angle
Stimulus_Properties.Label: German words: Ich (I), Fremder (stranger); Courier New 18-pt, approx 0.7 degrees visual angle

exp2.detail: Study 2: dot-probe task with long SOA (1000 ms, IOR) presented before the matching task. Matching task identical to Study 1. Data: 33 participants per author exp2_MT.lst (1-13, 15-34); raw txt exports available for 32 (Subject 34 has edat2 only, no txt/XML - trial-level data not recoverable, excluded from the database). Paper analysis N=31 (2 dot-probe RT outliers; IDs not disclosed in paper, determined by exhaustive enumeration as Subjects 24 and 30 - reproduced all paper statistics, see 2_Code/orellana2020_verify). Source: paper full text + OSF 3ke4f raw exports; [P] paper, [D] data.
